note: P2-HYGIENE (fb-91 class, 2026-09-06): the per-zone md5 MANIFEST the suite-integrity guard (scripts/r6-suite-guard.mjs) asserts against. It is a SNAPSHOT of the frozen file zones for change detection: each zone entry pins the file + its md5 span markers + the FROZEN zone md5. The guard compares the CURRENT source's zone md5 against this frozen value at START and END, closing the commit-drift observability gap documented in docs/VERIFICATION-LADDER.md §2 (a zone changed by a NEW HEAD leaves the worktree==HEAD mutation phases green — this manifest makes the drift fail loudly instead). The frozen value MUST stay byte-synced with the freeze lock literal asserted in test/tools-factory.test.js (the SAME CUT-4 zone; a re-freeze updates BOTH the test literal and this manifest in the SAME commit). CITATION RULE (2026-09-14, IPD builder-339): this header and the cut4 note below used to cite the freeze lock as `test/tools-factory.test.js:348`/`:458`/`:475`/`:488` — ALL FOUR were comments, never literals, and the asserted literal is the `assert.equal(md5, ...)` call. Cite the ASSERTION by its form (or by the zone/marker pair), never by line number: line numbers rotted twice here (the literal is the ONLY pinned site, and a bare number is not re-runnable).

snapshot.class: fb-1053 (this face) / fb-1063 (the sibling face in test/r6-ladder-flat.test.js): a guard that PHOTOGRAPHS a set and then compares it with a world that keeps MOVING. Such a guard can only honestly report drift AGAINST A PHOTO, so it must name WHAT the set is, WHICH side a zone lives on and WHEN the photo was taken.
snapshot.set: 14 frozen file zones. 13 of the 14 live OUTSIDE the repo (the INSTALLED harness, /usr/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh) and exactly ONE is in-repo (cut4-tools-zone). The guard DERIVES each zone's side from its RESOLVED path instead of trusting a field written here, so the 13x spread cannot rot into a stale claim.
snapshot.frozenAt: Per zone: the date that zone's CURRENT frozen md5 FIRST ENTERED this manifest — the age of that photo. Substantiating command, from the repo root: git log --format=%cs --reverse -S '"md5": "<value>"' -- scripts/zone-md5-manifest.json | head -1. A zone WITHOUT frozenAt is a photo whose date is NOT declared, and the guard then SAYS SO instead of inventing a date.
snapshot.driftSemantics: IN-REPO zone drifting = a COMMIT drift: the freeze lock (the assert.equal(md5, …) literal of test/tools-factory.test.js, cited by FORM and never by line number) AND this manifest must move in the SAME commit. INSTALLED-HARNESS zone drifting = NOT a repo-source drift: it moves when the host APPLIES a patch or upgrades dsh, and its re-freeze discipline is the A-HARNESS PORT rule of patches/README.md (re-freeze the zone in the SAME change that applies the patch). ONE host event can therefore drift up to 13 zones at once — the radius the guard now prints.
snapshot.notAttributed: WHY 13 of the 14 zones pin files outside the repo is NOT declared here and must not be invented: the spread may be DELIBERATE pinning (noticing that the installed harness moved under a repo is a legitimate guard function). What IS declared is the EFFECT the guard must state: a red on the installed-harness side is not a red of the repo source, and the two must never read alike.
snapshot.rowKinds: The guard renders THREE row kinds, each naming WHAT the set is, WHICH side it lives on and WHEN the photo was taken: (1) PIN UNRESOLVABLE — the pinned file is not readable from THIS checkout (the out-of-repo zones are pinned by a checkout-root-relative escape, so they resolve only where the photo was taken); (2) drift on the INSTALLED-HARNESS side; (3) drift on the REPO side.
snapshot.servingTarget:
SERVING-TARGET (measured 2026-09-15, builder-379 / 211aae46): the 13 a-harness-* zones pin the GLOBAL install (the @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 tree under the node_modules prefix /usr/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh), which is what SERVES today: /usr/bin/dsh is a symlink to ../lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js and the systemd unit runs that shim.

A CONMUTACION that repoints the unit at a VERSIONED TREE does NOT remove the global (the global IS the rollback path, by design) => these zones keep matching their frozen md5 while the FILE THEY PIN STOPS SERVING. That failure mode is GREEN-BY-md5 and is NOT detectable from this manifest: a green row here means the photo still matches, NOT that the pin still points at the tree in execution. This is the SAME class as the base-resolution and unit errors: a reference that stopped pointing at what it is believed to point at.

CHECK AT THE CONMUTACION (proposed for the HOST RUNBOOK checklist, NOT implemented here): after the swap, confirm the tree the unit is EXECUTING equals the tree the a-harness-* zones RESOLVE to; if they differ, this manifest is photographing a non-serving tree and its green rows must not be read as coverage.
snapshot.outOfScopeTrees: OUT OF SCOPE, DECIDED WITH MOTIVE (host, 2026-09-15): this manifest does NOT cover the DEPLOYMENT TREE (measured: 0 zone paths mention the versioned-trees prefix). The manifest is a PHOTO of a SET, and versioned trees are REPLACED BY DESIGN, so pinning their md5 would create a zone BORN STALE. The vehicle for anything that must SURVIVE a tree replacement is the patch chain (patches/ + the maintenance tsv), never this snapshot.
